description.zh: 电商转化的最后一公里：页面把收货信息、配送方式、支付方式和订单摘要组织成一条 不可回头的短流程，步骤条标示进度，表单尽量预填与自动更正，摘要常驻展示金额明细。 核心原则是每一步只问必要的信息，任何犹豫点（运费、总金额）都要提前说清楚。
description.en: The last mile of e-commerce conversion: shipping info, delivery method, payment and the order summary are arranged into one short forward-only flow — a stepper marks progress, forms are prefilled and auto-corrected, and the summary keeps totals always visible. Ask only what is necessary per step, and surface hesitation points (shipping cost, total) before they become objections.

use_when.zh: 购物车到支付的完整下单流程
use_when.en: Full purchase flow from cart to payment

use_when.zh: 需要分步收集收货、配送、支付信息
use_when.en: Collecting shipping, delivery and payment info in steps

use_when.zh: 需要同时展示金额明细与优惠减免
use_when.en: Totals and discounts must be visible throughout

avoid_when.zh: 单件虚拟商品的极简购买（一屏内完成更优）
avoid_when.en: Single digital-item purchase — one screen is better

avoid_when.zh: 浏览和挑选商品的商城首页
订阅升级（用定价页的升级弹层更轻）
avoid_when.en: Subscription upgrades — a pricing-page modal is lighter

note.zh: 所有信息一屏铺开，转化路径最短
note.en: Everything on one screen, shortest path

note.zh: 步骤条分段收集，长表单减压
note.en: Stepper splits the long form to reduce pressure

note.zh: 完成一段折叠一段，兼顾单页与分步
note.en: Completed sections collapse — one page with steps

note.zh: 一键支付按钮置顶，表单退居其次
note.en: Express-pay buttons on top, form secondary

note.zh: 购物车 → 信息 → 支付 → 完成，标明当前进度。
note.en: Cart to info to payment to done, marking current progress.

note.zh: 地址与卡信息分组，减少字段并支持自动填充。
note.en: Address and card grouped, minimized fields with autofill.

note.zh: 卡 / 钱包 / 分期并列，默认选中推荐方式。
note.en: Card, wallet or installments side by side, defaulting to the recommended one.

note.zh: 商品、运费、税费与合计，结算全程可见。
note.en: Items, shipping, tax and total, visible throughout checkout.

note.zh: 唯一致命操作，处理中禁用并给出反馈。
note.en: The single irreversible action, disabled with feedback while pending.

notes.zh: 多步流程用受控 step 状态 + 步骤条（可点击回退）；每步本地校验通过才放行。 订单摘要桌面端 sticky 右栏，移动端折叠成"合计 ¥xx"的可展开条。 表单输入配 autocomplete（name / postal-code / cc-number）、输入掩码与即时校验。 提交中禁用按钮并防重复下单；成功后跳转确认页。
notes.en: Multi-step flow uses controlled step state + a stepper (clickable to go back); each step validates locally before advancing. The summary is sticky right on desktop and a collapsed "Total ¥xx" bar on mobile. Inputs get autocomplete (name / postal-code / cc-number), input masks and inline validation. Disable the button while submitting to prevent duplicates; redirect to a confirmation page on success.

basic.zh: 创建一个结账页，包含收货表单、支付方式选择和订单摘要。
basic.en: Create a checkout page with a shipping form, payment options and an order summary.

design.zh: 创建三步结账页：顶部步骤条（收货 → 支付 → 确认）；左栏当前步表单（收货：姓名/地址/电话，即时校验；支付：卡号掩码与支付方式单选）；右栏 sticky 订单摘要（商品两行 + 运费 + 优惠 + 合计）；底部"提交订单"按钮带提交 loading。移动端摘要折叠。
design.en: Build a three-step checkout: stepper on top (Shipping → Payment → Review); left column holds the current step's form (shipping: name/address/phone with inline validation; payment: card number mask and payment method radios); right column a sticky order summary (two line items + shipping + discount + total); "Place order" button with loading state. Collapsed summary on mobile.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现结账页：step 受控 + 每步字段级校验；卡号输入掩码 （4 位分组）；金额计算抽成纯函数；摘要 sticky；提交态防重复； 支付方式单选受控；深浅色一致。不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind checkout: controlled step + per-step field validation; card-number input mask (4-digit groups); totals as a pure function; sticky summary; duplicate-submit guard; controlled payment radios; consistent light/dark. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现结账页。

先检查购物车数据结构、支付接口与表单组件，保持一致。
要求：
- 步骤条 + 分步表单（可回退），每步校验
- 订单摘要 sticky，金额明细完整
- 提交态防重复下单，成功跳转确认页
- 移动端摘要折叠
- 深浅色一致，不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the checkout page in the current project.

Inspect the cart data model, payment API and form components first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Stepper + step forms (back-navigable) with per-step validation
- Sticky order summary with full totals breakdown
- Duplicate-submit guard; redirect to confirmation on success
- Collapsed summary on mobile
- Consistent light/dark; no new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
